stance_rationale: Walk-forward weights and return coverage are materially better than a single-snapshot failure, but the package still fails mandatory forge audit items around 3-package Pure Function hashes, same-period baseline recomputation, DSR penalty parity, and target stage-artifact verification. The strict015 tie/retain recommendation is therefore not judge-ready without revision.

critical_concerns.description: Pure Function v6.1 R12 is only partially evidenced: output/pure_function_hash_audit_start_vs_end.json proves six source files unchanged, but the role prompt requires alpha/risk/optimization 3-package md5 start=end and target_weights/alpha_vector/cov immutability evidence; those package files are absent under WT-H20260513_002.

Baseline fairness is not proven because V2_admit_ub020 metrics are hard-coded from WT-H20260513_001 rather than recomputed in the same run, same period, same cost, and same DSR penalty frame. This is exactly the documented-baseline shortcut RF-F4 warns against.

DSR accounting is fragile: the package uses Bailey-LdP N=5 for strict015 and quotes admit DSR_N5, but does not expose candidates_tried_total via the prompt's candidates_tried × 0.05 convention or apply a visibly identical penalty to the baseline. Given the inherited V2/V6 search history, N=5 may understate the actual multiplicity burden.

The Harvey regression has five rows, but the mandatory fields are incomplete: only alpha_annual/t_NW/p/R2 are present, while alpha_monthly and per-spec DSR are missing. The FF6-equivalent row is labeled FF5_WML and lag4 is compared against admit lag6, leaving specification parity ambiguous.

The user-specified target stage artifacts qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-H20260513_002 and stage_artifacts/WT_H20260513_002 do not exist, so the requested alpha_scores.parquet time-series check and covariance.parquet PSD/condition<=100 post-shrink check cannot be performed for this WT.

The AX-007 exemption is asserted by precedent, but strict015 remains a top20 long-only single-sleeve with scalar overlays and does not clearly match the listed AX-007 exceptions. 'admit precedent inherit' is not a substitute for a fresh mechanism-level rebuttal.

supporting_arguments: weights.csv is a real walk-forward schedule: 267 unique sig_dates from 2004-01-01 to 2026-03-01, 20 names per date, sums equal 1, no negative weights, and max weight is 0.150000000000043 within tolerance.
period_returns_strict015.csv and nav_strict015.csv cover 267 realized months from 2004-02 to 2026-04; post-lockbox NAV has 27 rows after 2024-01-23, so RF-F3 line-discontinuity risk is low.
Required OOS charts for RF-F8 are present: equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png; scenario_comparison.png is absent but not one of the RF-F8 hard-required chart names.
Source alpha tables are time-series rather than single snapshots: WT_D20260425_010 alpha_scores and WT_D20260512_003 alpha_scores_new each have 268 dates from 2004-01-01 to 2026-04-01.
Turnover cost uses L1/2 turnover with explicit round-trip x2 in run_strict_015_variant.R, so RF-F7 is not triggered.
unresolved_disputes: No alpha_package.json, risk_package.json, optimization_package.json, or challenge_note files exist under WT-H20260513_002 for the requested 3-agent context audit.
No monthly_returns.parquet exists; the reported date range was inferred from period_returns_strict015.csv instead.
sr_lockbox_daily_harness is null and frozen buy-and-hold extension evidence is not explicit, even though post-lockbox monthly NAV and charts exist.
Target covariance.parquet for WT-H20260513_002 is missing, so PSD and condition-number checks cannot be tied to this package.
Actual candidates_tried_total for DSR should be adjudicated across the inherited V2/V6 search lineage, not just the strict015 rerun narrative.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that the strict015 versus admit tie decision is statistically fair when the admit baseline and DSR penalty are quoted from predecessor artifacts rather than recomputed under the same harness and multiplicity convention.
rebuttal_required: Provide alpha/risk/optimization package md5 start=end hash audit or explicitly identify immutable package substitutes accepted by the charter.
Recompute V2_admit_ub020 in the WT-H20260513_002 harness with identical 255m/267m windows, cost model, and DSR penalty.
Publish candidates_tried_total and recompute DSR for strict015 and admit under the same candidates_tried × 0.05 convention, including inherited grid/search counts if applicable.
Add alpha_monthly and per-spec DSR to all CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6/FF5_WML regression rows.
Provide the missing WT-H20260513_002 target stage artifacts or revise the package to state that this WT intentionally has no alpha/covariance stage outputs and why that is charter-compliant.
Replace AX-007 and AX-008 inheritance language with fresh evidence or downgrade those claims to unresolved.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Forge produced credible walk-forward weights and charts, but AX-008 cannot pass while Codex is pending, Architect is inherited/deferred, and core same-harness baseline plus 3-package hash evidence are missing.
